NEW_FAMILY_SINGLE_MEASUREMENT_REGIME_RUL.rule: A feature may enter the new family ONLY if the SAME frozen computation can be applied to (1) development history, (2) historical holdout where evidentiary use is allowed, and (3) true forward data.
NEW_FAMILY_SINGLE_MEASUREMENT_REGIME_RUL.corollary: legacy stored values may be used for provenance and conformance diagnostics, but NEVER as a substitute for the new-family computation
NEW_FAMILY_SINGLE_MEASUREMENT_REGIME_RUL.forbidden: any measurement-regime split, e.g. legacy stored values in development and a new Massive computation forward

MASSIVE_DATA_WINDOW.CONSTRAINT_HEAD: Massive begins 2021-08-25, roughly two months AFTER the legacy store head (2021-07-02) — the new-family development history is correspondingly shorter
MASSIVE_DATA_WINDOW.CONSTRAINT_TAIL: Massive ends 2026-08-24, two days BEFORE the legacy store (2026-08-26). The historical holdout on Massive is therefore 2026-08-07 .. 2026-08-24, NOT .. 08-26.
